87	
88	/-! ## The pulled-back overlap unit -/
89	
90	/-- **The overlap unit pulled back along `f`.** A unit on `V false ⊓ V true` pulls back to a
91	unit on the overlap of the two *preimage* charts — typed on the nose, since
92	`f ⁻¹ᵁ V false ⊓ f ⁻¹ᵁ V true` and `f ⁻¹ᵁ (V false ⊓ V true)` are the same open by
93	definitional unfolding of preimages. -/
94	noncomputable def pullbackOverlapUnit (f : X ⟶ Y) (u : Γ(Y, V false ⊓ V true)ˣ) :
95	    Γ(X, (fun s ↦ f ⁻¹ᵁ V s) false ⊓ (fun s ↦ f ⁻¹ᵁ V s) true)ˣ :=
96	  f.unitsAppLE (V false ⊓ V true) (f ⁻¹ᵁ V false ⊓ f ⁻¹ᵁ V true) le_rfl u
97	
98	/-- `pullbackOverlapUnit` is `unitsAppLE` of the first projection, definitionally — the
99	spelling `Hom.unitsAppLE` lemmas apply to. -/
100	theorem pullbackOverlapUnit_def (f : X ⟶ Y) (u : Γ(Y, V false ⊓ V true)ˣ) :
101	    pullbackOverlapUnit f u
102	      = f.unitsAppLE (V false ⊓ V true) (f ⁻¹ᵁ V false ⊓ f ⁻¹ᵁ V true) le_rfl u :=
103	  rfl
104	
105	/-- The pullback of an overlap unit is multiplicative. -/
106	theorem pullbackOverlapUnit_mul (f : X ⟶ Y) (u v : Γ(Y, V false ⊓ V true)ˣ) :
107	    pullbackOverlapUnit f (u * v)
108	      = pullbackOverlapUnit f u * pullbackOverlapUnit f v :=
109	  map_mul _ u v
110	
111	@[simp]
112	theorem pullbackOverlapUnit_one (f : X ⟶ Y) :
113	    pullbackOverlapUnit (V := V) f 1 = 1 :=
114	  map_one _
115	
116	/-! ## The cover identification -/
117	
118	/-- **The pulled-back two-chart cover is the two-chart cover of the preimages**, and it holds
119	by `rfl`: both pointed covers send `x` to `f ⁻¹ᵁ V (sel (f.base x))`.
120	
121	This is what removes every transport from the naturality proof. Were the two covers merely
122	*mutually refining*, the classes below would live in different `unitsH1` groups and would have
123	to be compared along a refinement; they do not. -/
124	theorem twoChartCover_pullback (f : X ⟶ Y) (sel : Y → Bool) (hmem : ∀ y, y ∈ V (sel y)) :

126	      = twoChartCover (fun s ↦ f ⁻¹ᵁ V s) (fun x ↦ sel (f.base x))
127	          (fun x ↦ hmem (f.base x)) :=
